Since theta<1/2 and decisions are synchronous, each round adds that frontier with independent probability 1/(s+2) and cannot add additional vertices. The Stirling recurrence gives the fixed-m tail, Borel–Cantelli proves a.s. completion, tail integrals the exact moments, and independent bounded Bernoulli increments plus CLT prove the log-time Gaussian m-limit.
